violated_contract: A signing decision must be keyed on an attribute read back from a real signature, never inferred from the spelling of the identity string. Local dev signing classified every identity that was not the literal "-" as a real identity and stripped its library-validation exception, but the documented self-signed "Omi Local Dev Signing" identity carries no Team ID (codesign reports TeamIdentifier=not set), so hardened-runtime library validation rejected the bundled Sparkle/Sentry/onnxruntime frameworks and the app could not launch. The failure is silent: `codesign --verify` passes and `open -a` exits 0.
canonical_prevention: Resolve the identity's Team ID from an actual signature, classify the signing mode from that resolved value in exactly one place, and let the same classification drive both the launch-safety gate and the generated entitlements, so a configuration that validates is exactly the configuration that gets signed. Identities that do carry a Team ID stay team-scoped and keep full library validation.
